name: Åre

seo.title: Åre ski resort guide
seo.description: Åre is Sweden's largest ski resort: 47 lifts, 91 slopes and 890 metres of vertical across three areas on one SkiPass.
seo.twitterDescription: 47 lifts, 91 slopes and 890 m of vertical across three ski areas on one SkiPass.
seo.webpageDescription: Ski facts, slope grades per area, where to stay and how to get to Åre in Jämtland, Sweden.

h1: Åre ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Åre is the largest ski resort in Sweden, and one SkiPass covers three separate areas: Åre by at the foot of Åreskutan, Åre Björnen laid out for children and beginners, and Duved/Tegefjäll eight kilometres down the valley. The vertical is 890 metres, the most in the country, and the season in Åre by opens on 11 December 2026.
stayOverview: Where you sleep in Åre decides which of the three ski areas you ski first. Åre by puts the funicular and the Kabinbanan within walking distance; Åre Björnen puts accommodation beside the beginner slopes; Duved and Tegefjäll trade the village for shorter lift queues and their own cheaper area pass.
hotelIntro: Book against high season rather than today's date: Åre by opens on 11 December 2026 and the Kabinbanan not until 8 February 2027, so the lift you expect to use may decide the week you book.
rentalCars: A car is useful in Åre only if you plan to move between Åre by, Åre Björnen and Duved/Tegefjäll on the same trip; the SkiStar ski bus is included with the SkiPass.

airports.name: Åre Östersund Airport
airports.text: SkiStar names Åre Östersund as the airport for Åre, with easyJet flying in from London Gatwick during the winter season.

travelTips.title: Which area
travelTips.text: Åre Björnen has 16 of its 18 slopes graded very easy or easy; Åre högzon has 8 of 15 graded intermediate and nothing below very easy. Pick the base that matches who is skiing.
travelTips.sourceLabel: SkiStar: Åre lifts, slopes and weather

travelTips.title: Opening dates
travelTips.text: Åre by opens 11 December 2026 and Bergbanan runs to 22:00 from 18 December. The Kabinbanan opens 8 February 2027.
travelTips.sourceLabel: SkiStar: Åre lifts, slopes and weather

travelTips.title: One pass, three areas
travelTips.text: The Åre SkiPass covers Åre by, Åre Björnen, Duved and Tegefjäll; a cheaper Area Pass covers Duved and Tegefjäll only.

travelTips.title: Ski bus
travelTips.text: The ski bus between accommodation and the ski areas is included with the SkiPass.

highlights.title: Åreskutan
highlights.text: The mountain above the village reaches the treeline and above it, where Åre högzon's 15 slopes run with no grade easier than very easy.
highlights.sourceLabel: SkiStar: Åre lifts, slopes and weather

highlights.title: Bergbanan funicular
highlights.text: The funicular leaves from the village square and runs until 22:00 from 18 December 2026 for evening skiing.
highlights.sourceLabel: SkiStar: Åre lifts, slopes and weather

highlights.title: Åre Björnen
highlights.text: A separate ski area for children and beginners, with a children's area, Valle activities and accommodation beside the pistes.

highlights.title: Duved and Tegefjäll
highlights.text: Twelve lifts and 19 slopes eight kilometres down the valley, sold on their own cheaper Area Pass.

highlights.title: Cross-country trails
highlights.text: Over 100 kilometres of prepared cross-country track from the village.

highlights.title: Snow Park
highlights.text: SkiStar runs snowparks in both Åre by and Duved/Tegefjäll, included in the SkiPass.

areas.name: Åre by
areas.text: The village at the foot of the slopes, with the funicular and the Kabinbanan from the square.

areas.name: Åre Björnen
areas.text: Accommodation right by the pistes in the area SkiStar lays out for children and beginners.
areas.bestFor: families, beginners, accommodation by the piste

areas.name: Duved
areas.text: Eight kilometres down the valley, with its own Area Pass covering Duved and Tegefjäll.
areas.bestFor: quieter stays, long wide runs, value

areas.name: Tegefjäll
areas.text: Shares the Duved/Tegefjäll area pass and its snowpark.

season.note: Åre by opens 11 December and Högzon runs to 2 May. The operator's season-opening page gives the same start; the areas inside Åre open and close on their own dates - Gondolen 18 December to 25 April, Björnen 18 December to 11 April.

pistes.note: The same page's introduction says 89; the Quick facts table says 91.

baseElevation.unannounced: SkiStar's Åre pages give 47 lifts, 91 slopes and 890 m of vertical, and its live slope report lists every lift and run, but no page states an altitude above sea level for the foot of the ski area.

longestRun.unannounced: SkiStar's Åre pages count the slopes and list them by grade in the live report, but publish no length for any of them and name no longest run.

dayPass.unannounced: SkiStar prices the SkiPass by booking date and states it is cheapest the earlier it is booked, so there is no fixed adult day rate.

skiEvents.name: Alpine skiing World Cup, Åre
skiEvents.note: Åre has hosted the Alpine World Ski Championships twice, in 1954 and 2019.
